_readme: Drop a new option folder (with spec.json + model) inside its category folder, then add the folder name to that category's options list below. Nothing in index.html / main.css / main.js needs to change.

instructor.text: Welcome to the capstone. Every drone you have built across the lab series — its propulsion, its mass, its power system — comes together here into one mission model: how much power it burns, how much energy it needs, and how far it can fly.

Start in Input Parameters — pick your components (the battery matters most for this capstone), then set the density altitude and payload sliders. Watch the Diagnostics Log for any build errors before you run.

Module 1 · Power Profiling sweeps airspeed from 2 to 20 m/s and plots cruise power against speed. Watch the U-shape emerge — parasitic drag rising with speed against the induced-power floor falling with it.
Module 1 · Endurance Speed reads the exact bottom of that U-curve. The speed at minimum power is the maximum-endurance speed — the airspeed that keeps the craft aloft longest per Watt-hour.

Module 2 · Mission Energy — set the takeoff, cruise, hover-on-station, return and landing durations, and watch the Watt-hour budget accumulate phase by phase. The verdict confirms whether the pack holds enough charge for the full mission.
Module 2 · Range–Payload sweeps payload across three battery packs to map the range-payload envelope — the primary deliverable of any UAV mission brief. Complete it to unlock the capstone reward.

reward.name: Payload Bay + Mission Spec
reward.desc: Capstone complete — payload bay locked in and the drone's mission envelope (optimal speed, endurance speed, range-payload limits) is finalized.
